main_axis.headline: You move by your own judgment and the momentum of people around you, and you rarely stop to check whether the direction is yours.
main_axis.body: The lead force is Companion — your own judgment and peers who move with you — and Rob Wealth, competition among peers and scrambling for resources, runs almost as heavy. Together they make you act first and sort out ownership later. The latent force is the Output family: Eating God, output that flows naturally, and Hurting Officer, the urge to speak out and challenge rules, sit in the branches but carry little weight, so the making-and-saying side of you is present but underfed.
main_axis.latent: Indirect Wealth, Direct Wealth, Seven Killings, Direct Officer, Indirect Resource, Direct Resource
main_axis.evidence: Companion and Rob Wealth are jointly heaviest (13 and 11): the year and month stems are both Companion, the hour stem is Rob Wealth, and hidden Rob Wealth appears in the month and day branches. The Output family is thin (Eating God 3, Hurting Officer 2) and appears only in hidden stems — Eating God in the year branch, Hurting Officer in the month and day branches. The Wealth, Officer-Killings, and Resource families all weigh zero.

core_loop.headline: You gather people and resources, act on your own read, and the result feeds straight back into more of the same.
core_loop.flow: In daily life this looks like starting things with people who think like you, then finding that the same people are competing for the same slots, credit, or budget. You respond by doubling down on your own judgment rather than pausing to renegotiate, so the circle tightens instead of widening. The output side — actually finishing and shipping something visible — is the part that gets skipped when the group dynamic takes over.
core_loop.driver: The Day Master is a Gui water stem with a chart labeled as having special-pattern characteristics; water fills seven of the eight visible characters, and Companion and Rob Wealth together carry twenty-four of the thirty-one Ten God weight points, so the self-and-peers axis dominates while the Output, Wealth, Officer-Killings, and Resource families are thin or hidden.
core_loop.leak:
The cost is that you keep moving with the same circle and the same self-reliant read, so finished, visible output stays thin and nothing accumulates on its own — savings, credentials, and standing all need someone to stop and build them.
It shifts in the ten years starting around age 39 (the Ji Wei pillar), when earth and fire enter the picture and the output-to-wealth side gets something to land on, and again in the ten years starting around age 49 (the Wu Wu pillar).
For now, before you commit to a group plan, write down one deliverable that is yours alone and finish it before the next round of coordination starts.
core_loop.evidence: Day Master is Gui water; the chart is flagged with special-pattern characteristics and the engine withholds favorable-element conclusions. Water counts seven of eight visible characters; Companion 13 and Rob Wealth 11 dominate the weights, while Eating God 3 and Hurting Officer 2 are the only other nonzero gods. The age-39 stretch is the Ji Wei pillar and the age-49 stretch is the Wu Wu pillar, both present in the luck-pillar list.

structure_type.name: the move-with-your-own-circle type
structure_type.one_line: You run on shared momentum and your own read of the situation, and you treat outside structure as something to route around rather than lean on.

capability_source.headline: Strongest when a group needs someone to just decide and start; weakest when the task requires patient, solitary building of a system or a track record.
capability_source.text: Your strength comes from the sheer weight of self-and-peers energy: you do not wait for permission, and you read a room fast because you are always already in one. A concrete scene: in a meeting where everyone is circling the same three options, you are the one who names a fourth and gets two people to try it that afternoon. The solitary, slow-accumulation side is where the chart is thin, and that is covered in the loop section.
capability_source.evidence: Companion 13 and Rob Wealth 11 dominate; the year and month stems are both Companion and the hour stem is Rob Wealth. The Output family is thin (Eating God 3, Hurting Officer 2) and hidden only, and the Resource family weighs zero, so there is little built-in pull toward solitary study or credential-building.

structure_fingerprint: Moves with peers and own judgment first, finishes visible output last, and rarely stops to renegotiate direction.
